description: One defect at a time put into a copy of the code; the tests are run against the copy. Killed means the tests failed.

outcomes.defect: a backtick string with no substitution is no longer read as a literal event name
outcomes.detail: test/lint-code.test.ts > lintSource: calls that match the plan > passes clean calls in several syntaxes and counts them

outcomes.defect: a value wrapped in `as` is no longer read through
outcomes.detail: test/lint-code.test.ts > lintSource: what cannot be decided is reported, never passed > reads through casts and parentheses

outcomes.defect: required properties are reported missing even when a spread may supply them
outcomes.detail: test/lint-code.test.ts > lintSource: what cannot be decided is reported, never passed > reports a spread once, and still checks the explicit keys

outcomes.defect: a property set to undefined counts as present
outcomes.detail: test/lint-code.test.ts > lintSource: what cannot be decided is reported, never passed > treats a literal undefined as absent

outcomes.defect: the enum test is inverted
outcomes.detail: test/lint-code.test.ts > lintSource: calls that match the plan > passes clean calls in several syntaxes and counts them

outcomes.defect: PII-shaped literals are reported even where the plan declares pii
outcomes.detail: test/lint-code.test.ts > lintSource: PII-shaped literals > accepts the same value in a property declared pii

outcomes.defect: event names are looked up with inherited keys (constructor, toString)
outcomes.detail: test/lint-code.test.ts > lintSource: findings and where they point > treats an inherited name as unknown

outcomes.defect: a non-literal event name is silently passed
outcomes.detail: test/lint-code.test.ts > lintSource: what cannot be decided is reported, never passed > reports a non-literal event name as unverifiable

outcomes.defect: a scan that found no tracker calls passes
outcomes.detail: test/lint-code.test.ts > lintPaths > fails a scan that finds no tracker calls at all

outcomes.defect: syntax errors are not reported
outcomes.detail: test/lint-code.test.ts > lintSource: syntax errors are not skipped quietly > reports a parse error with its position

outcomes.defect: this.analytics.track is never matched
outcomes.detail: test/lint-code.test.ts > lintSource: which calls count as tracker calls > uses the trackers it is given

outcomes.defect: literal type mismatches are not reported
outcomes.detail: test/lint-code.test.ts > lintSource: findings and where they point > reports every kind of literal type mismatch

outcomes.defect: maxDistinct of zero is accepted
outcomes.detail: test/plan.test.ts > parsePlan: refuses a malformed plan and says where > maxDistinct of zero

outcomes.defect: inherited names count as declared events
outcomes.detail: test/plan.test.ts > reserved and inherited names > looks events and properties up as own keys only

outcomes.defect: a one-step funnel is accepted
outcomes.detail: test/plan.test.ts > parsePlan: refuses a malformed plan and says where > funnel with one step

outcomes.defect: duplicate enum values are accepted
outcomes.detail: test/plan.test.ts > parsePlan: refuses a malformed plan and says where > an enum with a duplicate

outcomes.defect: a fractional number matches the integer type
outcomes.detail: test/plan.test.ts > parsePlan: refuses a malformed plan and says where > a fractional integer enum value

outcomes.defect: an event exactly at the lateness tolerance is called late
outcomes.detail: test/check-stream.test.ts > late events and clock skew > allows a delay exactly at the tolerance and flags one millisecond more

outcomes.defect: a clock exactly at the skew tolerance is called skewed
outcomes.detail: test/check-stream.test.ts > late events and clock skew > allows a client clock ahead by exactly the tolerance and flags one millisecond more

outcomes.defect: equal funnel timestamps are called out of order
outcomes.detail: test/check-stream.test.ts > funnel order > allows equal timestamps and does not require every step

outcomes.defect: duplicate event ids are not found
outcomes.detail: test/check-stream.test.ts > duplicate event ids > flags the second and later copies, and does not check a copy again

outcomes.defect: the distinct-value bound is off by one
outcomes.detail: test/check-stream.test.ts > high-cardinality properties > stays quiet at the bound and flags the first value past it, once per property

outcomes.defect: a stream with no events passes
outcomes.detail: test/check-stream.test.ts > a stream that checked nothing fails > reports no-events for empty input

outcomes.defect: PII-shaped values are reported even where the plan declares pii
outcomes.detail: test/check-stream.test.ts > PII-shaped values > accepts them in a property declared pii

outcomes.defect: a required property with a false or zero value counts as missing
outcomes.detail: test/check-stream.test.ts > schema conformance > flags a missing required property, and null in a required property as a type mismatch

outcomes.defect: an ISO timestamp without an offset is accepted
outcomes.detail: test/check-stream.test.ts > envelope problems > flags an ISO ts without an offset

outcomes.defect: a byte order mark is not removed
outcomes.detail: test/check-stream.test.ts > checkStreamFile > reads CRLF files, blank lines, a byte order mark and a last line with no newline, with true line numbers

outcomes.defect: a day is 86.4 seconds
outcomes.detail: test/check-stream.test.ts > parseDuration > reads units

outcomes.defect: the line length limit is not applied
outcomes.detail: test/check-stream.test.ts > invalid JSON > flags a line over the length limit without parsing it

outcomes.defect: events without received_at are not counted as unchecked
outcomes.detail: test/check-stream.test.ts > envelope problems > flags a received_at that is missing when it is required, and otherwise says it was not checked

outcomes.defect: the covariance term of the delta method has the wrong sign
outcomes.detail: test/stats.test.ts > ratioInterval: the delta method > hand-computed: four users, requests x = [2, 4, 3, 3], successes y = [1, 2, 1, 2]

outcomes.defect: the ratio is not squared in the delta method
outcomes.detail: test/stats.test.ts > ratioInterval: the delta method > hand-computed: four users, requests x = [2, 4, 3, 3], successes y = [1, 2, 1, 2]

outcomes.defect: the delta method divides by the mean of the denominator, not its square
outcomes.detail: test/stats.test.ts > ratioInterval: the delta method > hand-computed: four users, requests x = [2, 4, 3, 3], successes y = [1, 2, 1, 2]

outcomes.defect: the variance of the denominator uses n instead of n - 1
outcomes.detail: test/stats.test.ts > Moments2 > matches a direct two-pass computation on random data

outcomes.defect: the chi-square test has one degree of freedom too many
outcomes.detail: test/stats.test.ts > srmTest > hand-computed: 5000 vs 5200 users on a 50/50 split

outcomes.defect: the chi-square statistic is not divided by the expected count
outcomes.detail: test/stats.test.ts > srmTest > hand-computed: 5000 vs 5200 users on a 50/50 split

outcomes.defect: the control arm adds no variance to the difference
outcomes.detail: test/stats.test.ts > ratioDifference > subtracts the estimates and adds the variances of two independent arms

outcomes.defect: the CUPED slope is halved
outcomes.detail: test/stats.test.ts > cuped > hand-computed: theta = 2, the same difference, and a variance cut to one sixth

outcomes.defect: the upper tail of the normal quantile has the wrong sign
outcomes.detail: test/stats.test.ts > normalQuantile > p=0.995

outcomes.defect: merging two sets of moments weighs them wrongly
outcomes.detail: test/stats.test.ts > Moments2.merge > equals pushing every pair into one accumulator

outcomes.defect: the series branch of the incomplete gamma function returns the wrong tail
outcomes.detail: test/stats.test.ts > normalQuantile > p=0.95

outcomes.defect: an interval is computed from a single unit
outcomes.detail: test/stats.test.ts > ratioInterval: the delta method > refuses what it cannot compute

outcomes.defect: a user in two arms is not noticed
outcomes.detail: test/readout.test.ts > ReadoutAccumulator: what it refuses to pass > excludes a user who appears in two arms and says so

outcomes.defect: the sample ratio verdict is inverted
outcomes.detail: test/readout.test.ts > ReadoutAccumulator: hand-computed data > has no findings and counts users and rows

outcomes.defect: an arm with one user gets an interval
outcomes.detail: test/readout.test.ts > ReadoutAccumulator: what it refuses to pass > fails an arm with fewer than two users and gives no interval for it

outcomes.defect: a row without x counts as zero requests
outcomes.detail: test/readout.test.ts > reading files > runs end to end on a JSONL file, with a default x of 1, blank lines and a byte order mark

outcomes.defect: an interval that excludes zero is never reported as such
outcomes.detail: test/readout.test.ts > ReadoutAccumulator: does the interval exclude zero > says so for a clear increase, both ways of building the interval

outcomes.defect: rows of an arm that is not in the plan are analysed
outcomes.detail: test/readout.test.ts > ReadoutAccumulator: what it refuses to pass > fails an arm that is not in the plan and does not analyse its rows

outcomes.defect: the width ratio is upside down
outcomes.detail: test/readout.test.ts > ReadoutAccumulator: hand-computed data > compares each arm with the control the same two ways

outcomes.defect: the request-level interval is built from user totals
outcomes.detail: test/readout.test.ts > ReadoutAccumulator: hand-computed data > has no findings and counts users and rows

outcomes.defect: a phone shape is matched inside a longer digit run
outcomes.detail: test/pii.test.ts > detectPii: values that are not flagged > does not match the tail of a longer dashed or dotted number

outcomes.defect: any text containing @ is called an email
outcomes.detail: test/pii.test.ts > detectPii: values that are not flagged > does not flag "user@"

outcomes.defect: lint-code exits 0 whatever it finds
outcomes.detail: test/cli.test.ts > eqg lint-code > fails the planted-fault sample with file:line:column findings

outcomes.defect: running eqg with no command exits 0
outcomes.detail: test/cli.test.ts > eqg: help and version > exits 2 with usage when there is no command or an unknown one

outcomes.defect: check-stream passes a stream with exactly one finding
outcomes.detail: test/cli.test.ts > eqg check-stream > fails an empty file, because nothing was checked

outcomes.defect: validate-plan exits 0 for an invalid plan
outcomes.detail: test/cli.test.ts > eqg validate-plan > exits 1 and lists every problem for an invalid plan, and 2 when the file cannot be read
